summary: WISeKey filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary SEALSQ entered a subscription agreement for $10 million of Pubco ordinary shares in connection with the proposed SPAC business combination among Columbus Acquisition Corp. (CAC), SpaceAIQ (WISeSat.Space Corp.), and Pubco. The subscription price equals the redemption price per CAC share (~$10.66 as of June 30, 2026, implying ~938,086 shares). The parties also amended the business combination agreement to extend the outside date to October 31, 2026. SEALSQ and WISeKey are sellers under the agreement. This is a PIPE subscription supporting the SPAC merger. Watch for shareholder redemption levels and closing conditions; the extended outside date signals ongoing process.
